articles.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
articles.description: Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, allowing computers running the world's most popular OS to be used as a locally run AI system. Like the Mac version that Perplexity launched in April, Personal Computer for Windows operates like a "general-purpose digital worker" that can access local files and apps to perform […]

items.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
items.summary: Perplexity将Personal Computer工具扩展至Windows，使其成为可访问本地文件的AI代理系统。
items.why_it_matters: Windows用户现可使用本地AI系统处理任务，降低云端依赖并提升隐私安全性。

items.title: Smart rings are looking like my kind of AI gadget
items.summary: 语音识别技术显著提升，智能戒指等AI设备因便捷交互和低成本模型受关注。
items.why_it_matters: 低成本模型提升语音处理能力，推动AI硬件在便携场景落地并改变人机交互方式。

items.title: Hugging Face is being used to easily undress women and children
items.summary: 报告显示Hugging Face上多数图像编辑模型被用于生成非自愿深度伪造内容。
items.why_it_matters: 开源平台缺乏有效监管，加剧非自愿色情内容的传播风险并引发伦理担忧。

items.title: AI’s finally expensive enough to make Wall Street nervous
items.summary: 谷歌上调资本支出预估至最高2050亿美元，引发华尔街对AI成本过高担忧。
items.why_it_matters: 巨额投入可能压缩利润空间，影响市场对AI商业化前景的信心及股价表现。
